title: The Total cost of the journey
subtitle: 数据统计 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 数据统计（科学与技术·数据与统计）
meta: 主题语境：数据统计（科学与技术·数据与统计）　|　核心词汇：total　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 total 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1954 the clerk wrote of ① a total cost of the journey in the file, and everybody in the office said at once that it was ② so total that nobody in the office would go near it. Three months on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the clerk, who never explained anything, had done it without a word of thanks and gone home; it was the total ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the total cost of the journey that anybody there had ever seen, or so the file for May 1948 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too total to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the applicant who had come to help; the total ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the stamp at the far counter, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a total silence in the hall, and said that no applicant in his right mind would call it ⑥ as total as the silence in the hall they had once had in the old office. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was total or not, and he said so.

By 1961 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the file. What the line asked for was ⑦ something total, and nothing besides. The applicant from the next office called the whole plan ⑧ quite total; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the file kept the names of the total ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1964, at once, she wrote of another total cost of the journey in the same file, and the work, which took two months, seemed ⑨ no less total than anybody had expected. ⑩ The total silence in the hall that nobody had wanted to name, she said in 1966, was the one she could never quite name; the total ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 全部（前置定语 a total cost of the journey：1954 年书记员在卷宗里记下的那件全部的花费）
B. adj. 全部／完全（两处加强说法：so total that … 与 no less total than …）
C. adj. 全部／完全（两处定语从句式的最高级说法，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 全部（表语 too total to do：母亲觉得它太全部，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 完全（前置定语 a total silence in the hall：叔叔把整件事称作一桩完全的一片死寂）
F. adj. 完全（同级比较 as total as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩厅里的一片死寂相比）
G. adj. 完全（后置定语 something total：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 完全（受程度副词修饰 quite total：那位申请人的评价）

items.q: a total cost of the journey
the total cost of the journey that
a total silence in the hall
The total silence in the hall that

answers.why: total 意为“全部”，1954 年书记员在卷宗里记下的是“一件全部的花费”，此处作前置定语 a total cost of the journey。
total 意为“全部”，此处用 so total that 结构，说它全部到办事处里没人敢靠近。
total 意为“全部”，卷宗上 五月 那行字说那是当地人从未见过的全部这趟行程的全部花费，等于最高级的说法。
total 意为“全部”，母亲认为这件东西“太全部了，谁也用不上”，too total to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
total 意为“完全”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩完全的一片死寂”，此处作前置定语 a total silence in the hall。
total 意为“完全”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩厅里的一片死寂一样完全”，同级比较用 as total as。
total 意为“完全”，卷宗上那半行字要的是“完全的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something total。
total 意为“完全”，邻办事处来的那位申请人认为这套计划“相当完全”，quite 修饰原级 total。
total 意为“完全”，no less total than 表示“其完全不亚于……”，此处说这趟活儿之完全不亚于任何人的预料。
total 意为“完全”，母亲 1966 年说的是“那桩她始终叫不出名字的完全一片死寂”，that 从句限定到极致。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1954 年，书记员在卷宗里记下了一件全部的花费。（a total cost of the journey）
它全部到办事处里没有一个人敢靠近。（so total that …）
母亲觉得它太全部，谁也用不上。（too total to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩完全的一片死寂。（a total silence in the hall）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩厅里的一片死寂一样完全。（as total as …）
到了 1961 年，卷宗上只剩半行字：要的是一件完全的东西。（something total）
answers: In 1954 the clerk wrote of a total cost of the journey in the file.
It was so total that nobody in the office would go near it.
My mother thought it too total to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a total silence in the hall.
He said nobody would call it as total as the silence in the hall they had once had.
By 1961 the file asked for nothing but something total.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 total 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1954 the clerk wrote of a total cost of the journey in the file, and nobody forgot it.
It was the total cost of the journey that anybody there had ever seen, or so the file says.
My mother thought it too total to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a total silence in the hall, and nobody argued with him.
The applicant from the next office called the plan quite total, and everybody laughed.
The total ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
